</div></div></div><div class="fe-block fe-block-273825f3acc59acfc721"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-html html-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/c1bfc41a-46c9-470b-b2eb-d4ecdb81ee26_984/website.components.html.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/c1bfc41a-46c9-470b-b2eb-d4ecdb81ee26_984/website.components.html.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.html" data-sqsp-block="text" data-website-component-id="273825f3acc59acfc721" id="block-273825f3acc59acfc721"><div class="sqs-block-content"><div class="sqs-text-block-container">
  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">So who’s<br>“Hondo” anyway?</h2></div>
<style id="container-styles"></style>
<style id="override-container-styles"></style>
<style class="transform-overrides-vars"></style>
</div>
</div></div></div><div class="fe-block fe-block-5ee4d4cedcfb85b06603"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-html html-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/c1bfc41a-46c9-470b-b2eb-d4ecdb81ee26_984/website.components.html.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/c1bfc41a-46c9-470b-b2eb-d4ecdb81ee26_984/website.components.html.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.html" data-sqsp-block="text" data-website-component-id="5ee4d4cedcfb85b06603" id="block-5ee4d4cedcfb85b06603"><div class="sqs-block-content"><div class="sqs-text-block-container">
  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Before the hotel was built in 2020, there was a small <em>carniceria</em> (butchershop) on the property where the hotel now sits. <br><br>During the hotel’s construction, a large, blue-eyed mutt made frequented the site, likely drawn to us by his memories of beef, bones, and other doggy delights from the carniceria.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">But “Hondo,” as he was soon named, was not in great health. Local vets rushed in to save his life as he faced several diseases as well as abuse from his previous life. He became a wonderful watchdog on the property, and was later adopted to an American family.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Hotel Hondo honors his story, as well as the story of many stray other dogs in Baja. Charitable groups such as <a href="https://cortezrescue.org">Cortez Rescue</a> work tirelessly to save these pups, and change the culture of spay/neuter in Mexico. </p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Learn more about their mission <a href="https://cortezrescue.org">here</a>. </p></div>
<style id="container-styles"></style>
<style id="override-container-styles"></style>
<style class="transform-overrides-vars"></style>
</div>
</div></div></div></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
